entries.37d3e05fa22737c4: In line with its management philosophy, it aims to further strengthen its unique core technologies developed over many years, build its own business domain by making comprehensive use of these technologies, and further enhance its positioning as a development-oriented company whose value is recognized by customers. It positions business focus and differentiation from other companies as key strategies, and intends to concentrate management resources on business fields and markets with future growth potential; in manufacturing and sales, it will focus on differentiating coating products and high-performance resin products and launching new high-value-added products, and in purchasing and sales, it will focus on joint development and other collaboration with suppliers and on acquiring new trading rights. In its global expansion, it places emerging markets such as China, Thailand, Vietnam and India at the center of its business activities, using subsidiaries in various parts of Asia as bases, and it will also strengthen production, logistics and sales functions in the United States and Europe.
